command:
failed=0
printf '\nCONTROL 0\n'
sh -c 'date --iso-8601=seconds'
result=$?
printf 'CONTROL_EXIT 0=%s\n' "$result"
[ "$result" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
printf '\nCONTROL 1\n'
sh -c 'cat /opt/bussassistent/current/release-identity.json'
result=$?
printf 'CONTROL_EXIT 1=%s\n' "$result"
[ "$result" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
printf '\nCONTROL 2\n'
sh -c 'cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id'
result=$?
printf 'CONTROL_EXIT 2=%s\n' "$result"
[ "$result" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
printf '\nCONTROL 3\n'
sh -c uptime
result=$?
printf 'CONTROL_EXIT 3=%s\n' "$result"
[ "$result" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
printf '\nCONTROL 4\n'
sh -c 'uname -r'
result=$?
printf 'CONTROL_EXIT 4=%s\n' "$result"
[ "$result" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
printf '\nCONTROL 5\n'
sh -c 'systemctl --failed --no-pager'
result=$?
printf 'CONTROL_EXIT 5=%s\n' "$result"
[ "$result" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
printf '\nCONTROL 6\n'
sh -c 'systemctl show cloudflared -p MainPID -p NRestarts -p ActiveEnterTimestamp'
result=$?
printf 'CONTROL_EXIT 6=%s\n' "$result"
[ "$result" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
printf '\nCONTROL 7\n'
sh -c 'systemctl list-timers bussassistent-backup.timer --no-pager'
result=$?
printf 'CONTROL_EXIT 7=%s\n' "$result"
[ "$result" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
printf '\nCONTROL 8\n'
sh -c 'systemctl show bussassistent-backup.service -p Result -p ExecMainStatus -p ActiveEnterTimestamp'
result=$?
printf 'CONTROL_EXIT 8=%s\n' "$result"
[ "$result" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
printf '\nCONTROL 9\n'
sh -c 'curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:18083/ready'
result=$?
printf 'CONTROL_EXIT 9=%s\n' "$result"
[ "$result" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
printf '\nCONTROL 10\n'
sh -c 'sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/bussassistentctl check'
result=$?
printf 'CONTROL_EXIT 10=%s\n' "$result"
[ "$result" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
printf '\nCONTROL 11\n'
sh -c 'sudo -n /usr/local/sbin/bussassistentctl status'
result=$?
printf 'CONTROL_EXIT 11=%s\n' "$result"
[ "$result" -eq 0 ] || failed=1
exit "$failed"
